prompt: Create an original 150 second West African acoustic instrumental instrumental composition for nature documentary, landscape and gentle exploration. Mood: organic, open, fresh. Instruments: kora, balafon, calabash percussion. Style: interlocking plucked patterns and buoyant polyrhythm. Tempo approximately 102 BPM; D dorian. Main idea: a descending melody with an upward answer. Introduce a gently rising motif and a sense of open air. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:50] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:50-01:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:40-02:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 02:30.

description.en: A calm and reflective instrumental piece featuring a harp-like plucked string instrument, a flute melody, and sustained pads. It evokes a peaceful, traditional folk atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首平静而沉思的器乐作品，以竖琴般的拨弦乐器、长笛旋律和持续的衬底音为主。它营造出一种宁静、传统的民谣氛围。
